generator_metadata.summary: A sparse same-size recoloring task. Row 0 contains two to four ordered source/destination color pairs, displayed as source, zero, destination triplets with an optional leading zero offset. Row 1 is a blank separator. Every source color appears in multiple body components below the separator. The output preserves row 0 and all geometry, replaces each body source color with its paired destination color, and leaves background plus at most one unmapped distractor color unchanged.

review_brief:
# Review — 70913cf98cee
Task/source: assignment `review-2f0a7090596a5f39`; base generator SHA-256 `0ffbdc636859321577beb904ba9356bab7b722ab43ed910d9fc4e19e598930c5`.
Status: reviewer-ready native prototype; owner acceptance and training admission were not performed.
Defect → repair: ambiguous two-demo lessons → 3/4-pair anchors covering every destination, both orientations, exact-size/four-connectivity traps, and nuisance controls.
Canonical rule: unchanged exact default; program SHA-256 `cfa85dd4cc6635192e5c6cd410a8f16b2ccf141eacb8b20b555598ab321ef350`.
Variant: A maps legend sources to destinations; B cycles exact post-A destination dominoes to the next destination color.
Focused tests: 15/15 passed (`checks/70913cf98cee-tests-final/result.json`).
Adversarial review: 128 minimum lessons × 19 rivals = 2,304 checks; zero teaching holes (`checks/70913cf98cee/adversarial-report.json`).
Sampler review: 512 episodes, 5,120 labels, 512 crossed controls, 256 substantive 30×30 scenes (`checks/70913cf98cee/sampler-stress.json`).
Protected Racket: 32 label evaluations plus source-bound authoring preflight (`checks/70913cf98cee/qualification/qualification.json`).
Causal witness: wrong-order execution changes 12 final cells (`checks/70913cf98cee/causal/witness.json`, `checks/70913cf98cee/causal/check.json`).
Export review: 16 one-query views, 24 invariance mutations, four positive controls, six fail-closed corruptions.

## Concrete attacks and repairs

The first rival pass found last-pair-only, orientation-only, and previous-color
rules that fit some minimum lessons and changed queries. The sampler was changed
constructively rather than by adding retries or more demonstrations. A later pass
found size-≤2 and eight-connected bypasses, repaired with diagonal singleton
controls. Crossed-control stress then found the 3-pair anchor lacked an unmapped
nuisance component; that control was added and the failed case rerun.

The final bank also contains A-created dominoes and apparent source dominoes that
A destroys by merging into triominoes. The retained protected counterfactual runs
B before A on a qualified query and differs from the full A→B result, including a
mixed source/destination pair that qualifies only after A.

## Finite limits

The rival bank, seed sweeps, numeric corruptions, and private-field mutations are
bounded tests, not proofs of universal identifiability o

scope: Accepted generator repair; finite reviewer evidence, no new maintainer execution

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The post-A grid partitioned into 4-connected destination-color components; A can create a domino by merging unlike source/destination neighbors or destroy an apparent source domino by merging it into a larger component.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Apply the row-0 source-to-destination legend recolor to every body cell while preserving the header and geometry.
sequential_dependency.step_b: On that post-A component graph, recolor every exact two-cell destination component to the next destination color in cyclic legend order.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: B cannot choose its qualifying components from the original grid: A changes both colors and 4-connected component sizes. Running B before A misses mixed source/destination dominoes and can act on a different set of pre-existing destination components.

parametric_work.summary: Exact canonical direct recolor plus cycle_dominoes, where B consumes post-A four-connected destination components. Supports 2–6 demonstrations and four distinct queries, including a substantive 30x30 case; minimum lessons reject the retained finite rival bank.

target_report.summary: Built a reviewer-ready two-setting native family with the exact canonical default and a post-recolor component-topology variant; repaired all observed two-demo teaching holes, added reusable adversarial/sampler tools, and retained protected-Racket, causal, and public-export evidence.
